headline: New tariffs now reach almost all of US trade
summary: New duties took effect overnight at ten to twelve and a half percent, targeting sixty economies under the forced labour provisions of the Trade Act of 1974.
script: New American tariffs took effect overnight, ten percent on the European Union, Canada, Mexico and India, and twelve and a half percent on China, Japan and South Korea. They cover about ninety nine percent of U.S. trade.
